summary: Align compatibility coverage with the one-way causal-thread privacy floor

schema.detail: Storage behavior is unchanged; compatibility tests derive the floor from the schema constant.

rules.detail: No authorization or runtime behavior changes.

compatibility.detail: The emptied-record-bytes probe now verifies that obsolete readers refuse the upgraded store without changing its file, version or records-gone marker, then verifies current-build recovery and replication.

manual.detail: Rollback across the privacy floor still requires restoring a pre-upgrade backup.
